overview_description.description:
Our objective is to develop into the region's one-stop store for automotive components. By gathering demand and linking all players throughout the supply chain, including producers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, service providers, and customers, we are digitizing the automobile aftermarket sector in Latin America.

Meru was established in 2020 in Mexico City, Distrito Federal.
